name: Samsung SDI Co., Ltd. (삼성SDI)
summary: BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT: Samsung SDI's seven-quarter loss streak ended in Q2 2026 on AI data-center demand — UPS and BBU high-power batteries plus utility-scale SBB systems — and the company is converting EV capacity to US-made LFP ESS cells (production from October 2026) while marketing itself as 'the only non-Chinese prismatic ESS battery manufacturer operating in the US.' BACKGROUND: Founded 1970; Korean battery and electronic-materials maker (two divisions; 11 manufacturing sites, 21,887 patents claimed). EV batteries (prismatic + 46-series cylindrical; BMW, Audi, Rivian, Jeep concentration per SNE; Mercedes-Benz added April 2026), the SBB (Samsung Battery Box) ESS line, UPS/BBU data-center batteries, a 2027-targeted all-solid-state program, and semiconductor/display materials. FY2025 was the trough: operating loss KRW 1.72T.
ecosystemRole: We assess Samsung SDI as the premium-chemistry counterweight in the ESS supply chain: small global share (#12 in H1 2026, 1.4%) but differentiated where this app's readers care — high-power NCA/LMO products for data-center UPS/BBU (guided to grow >70% in 2026), fire-safety credentials aimed at hyperscaler procurement (world-first UL indoor large-scale fire test pass for UPS batteries), and a non-FEOC US supply chain with LFP cells from the StarPlus Indiana JV. 1.6 GWh of its H1 2026 ESS shipments went to AI data centers (SNE).

productsAndServices.name: ESS — Samsung Battery Box (SBB) Line
productsAndServices.description: All-in-one 20-ft DC containers shipped pre-tested ('Plug & Play'), liquid-cooled: SBB 1.5 (NCA, 5.26 MWh), SBB 1.7 (NCA, 6.14 MWh — US production from 2026), and SBB 2.0 (first LFP SBB — US production from 2026, deliveries before end-2026). Safety stack: EDI direct-injection extinguishing, 'No TP' thermal-propagation prevention, and SBI AI fire-prevention software.
highlights: March 2026: KRW 1.5T (~$1B) 4-year US ESS prismatic deal (NCA→LFP, StarPlus Indiana cells); December 2025: >KRW 2T 3-year US LFP deal from 2027 delivered as SBB 2.0 — both customers undisclosed

US prismatic LFP cell production starts October 2026 at StarPlus (Stellantis JV) toward a 30 GWh BESS cell target by end-2026; company says demand exceeds capacity from 2028, orders booked through 2029
NextEra multi-project supply deal (2024); Tesvolt (Germany) SBB deliveries; Korea East-West Power global partnership (Feb 2026)
productsAndServices.positioning: Small share in a Chinese-LFP-dominated market (Samsung SDI + LGES combined ~4% of 2025 ESS batteries) — the pitch is premium safety, non-FEOC compliance, and US-made cells rather than price. Company claim: 'North America's sole non-Chinese supplier of prismatic ESS batteries.'
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Direct system/cell supply to US utilities, developers, and European commercial-storage channel partners
productsAndServices.targetSegments: US utility-scale storage, European C&I (Tesvolt), global utility partnerships
productsAndServices.roadmap: SBB 2.0 (LFP) deliveries by end-2026; LFP cathode secured via a ~KRW 1.6T L&F deal building a non-FEOC chain

productsAndServices.name: Data-Center UPS & BBU Batteries
productsAndServices.description: U8A1 UPS solution (high-power LMO prismatic; +33% space efficiency; positioned for AI data-center peak-demand stabilization) and rack-level BBUs on high-capacity cylindrical cells. Company guides UPS+BBU sales to grow more than 70% YoY in 2026; InterBattery 2026 booth was a data-center replica ('AI thinks, Battery enables').
highlights: World-first pass of UL's Indoor Large-Scale Fire Test for UPS batteries (July 2026) — no propagation, no sprinklers; framed as a hyperscaler procurement requirement

~KRW 2T BBU cell supply chain via Taiwan's Simplo for AI data centers; end customers reportedly include Amazon and Meta (trade-press sourcing, not company-confirmed); SDI and Panasonic both reported supply-short in BBU cells
Q2 2026 return to profit explicitly attributed to these AI-DC product lines
productsAndServices.positioning: Competes with Panasonic (which claims ~80% of DC distributed-power systems) in the BBU niche NVIDIA's rack power-smoothing architecture is expanding; safety certification is the differentiation wedge
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Cells via pack partners (Simplo) and direct UPS solutions

productsAndServices.name: EV Batteries & Next-Gen (Solid-State)
productsAndServices.description: Prismatic (P6) and newly mass-produced 46-series cylindrical cells; high-nickel NCA/NCM plus LFP/mid-nickel expansion. JVs: StarPlus Energy (Stellantis, operating; ESS conversion underway) and GM (New Carlisle, IN — production pushed to 2027). All-solid-state 'SolidStack' program targets 2027 mass production (company-claimed world-first), with a pouch ASB for robots ('physical AI') targeted H2 2027; BMW co-development.
highlights: Mercedes-Benz multi-year NCM supply signed April 2026 — now supplies all three German premium OEMs
SNE flags concentration in BMW, Audi, Rivian, Jeep; global EV share slipped to #9 at 2.4% in 2025
Feb 2025: ~180,000 PHEV packs recalled (Chrysler/Jeep 4xe, Ford, VW, Audi) over fire risk
productsAndServices.positioning: Premium-chemistry specialist squeezed between CATL/BYD scale and LGES's broader book — the ESS/AI-DC pivot is explicitly the recovery route while EV demand stays soft
productsAndServices.roadmap: US LFP Oct 2026 · GM JV production 2027 · ASB mass production 2027 · sodium-ion advancement listed for H2 2026

productsAndServices.name: Electronic Materials
productsAndServices.description: Semiconductor process materials (SOH/SOD, CMP slurry, EMC, EUV photoresist), OLED/display materials, and coated battery separators. Consistently profitable (Q2 2026 OP KRW 44.5B) while the battery division swung.
highlights: The quiet stabilizer through seven battery-loss quarters

strategyRead: (High confidence) We assess AI data-center power is the company's chosen recovery vector, not incidental demand: UPS+BBU guided to +70% in 2026, the InterBattery booth literally rebuilt a data center, and the Q2 2026 turnaround was company-attributed to those lines. Basis: earnings releases and product roadmap.

(Moderate confidence) We assess the US LFP conversion (StarPlus, October 2026) is the pivotal execution item: both billion-dollar-class US ESS deals and the claimed through-2029 order book depend on it landing on time; the L&F cathode deal shows the FEOC-compliant chain is being built deliberately.

(Moderate confidence) We assess safety certification is the deliberate differentiation strategy against Chinese LFP price leaders — EDI/No TP/SBI plus the UL fire-test world-first target the one dimension hyperscalers and US utilities will pay premium for.

(Moderate confidence) We assess profit quality is the near-term watch item: the Q2 2026 profit included US tariff refunds, AMPC credits are load-bearing, and seven loss quarters preceded it — one profitable quarter is a turn signal, not a trend. The reported Tesla and Amazon deals (both unconfirmed) are the upside options that would change the trajectory materially.
(Low confidence) Trade press reports Amazon and Meta as end customers of the Simplo BBU chain and Amazon in direct battery-supply talks — none company-confirmed; treat as unverified reporting.
